notes.title: Patch 1.11
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Here are today’s bug fixes:

- Fixed an issue at 900 meters where the glass ground wasn’t making the ball jump.
- Resolved strange visual artifacts that appeared just before the final cutscene.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Patch 1.09
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

A new patch just dropped with some small but useful improvements:

- Drop shadow is now enabled by default when launching the game for the first time.
- Music and Cinematic volume are set to 75% on first startup.
- Adjusted some challenges for a better experience.
- Added a game icon when minimizing the game.
